title: Establishment of Hillside Development Area
text:
19.27.010 Establishment of Hillside Development Area.
The Hillside Development Area is established and consists of the area bound by the Mountain Development Area (MDA) and the Texas-New Mexico State boundary line, Interstate Highway 10, Paisano Drive, Executive Center Boulevard, Mesa Street, Schuster Avenue, Murchison Drive, Arizona Avenue, Alabama Street, Magnetic Drive, Hondo Pass Avenue, U.S. Highway 54 and Martin Luther King, Jr. Boulevard and as more particularly described in the boundary map at Appendix 112.
(Ord. No. 17349, § 2, 7-13-2010)
